title: Cash Basis by the Work Owed, Optional Coverage Add-Ons
content:
**Claims guidance.** The cash basis for a cash settlement under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons follows the work owed on the request being settled, judged in this order:

1. **Repair guarantee.** When a repair of the same component was authorized on the rider no more than the rider's repair guarantee period before the settlement date, the contractor's repair guarantee carries the work, and the cash basis is zero. The repair guarantee period is 30 calendar days for every rider.
2. **Repair owed.** Otherwise, when a repair estimate above zero is recorded and is below the rider's repair-to-replace threshold rate times the contracted replacement cost, a repair is owed, and the cash basis is the repair estimate. The threshold rate is 0.60 (60 percent) for every rider.
3. **Replacement owed.** Otherwise a replacement is owed, and the cash basis is the contracted replacement cost.

| Same-component repair authorized on the rider within the past 30 calendar days | Repair estimate on the covered determination | Work owed | Cash basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Any | Carried by the repair guarantee | Zero |
| No | Above zero and below 0.60 of the contracted replacement cost | Repair | The repair estimate |
| No | At or above 0.60 of the contracted replacement cost | Replacement | The contracted replacement cost |
| No | None above zero recorded | Replacement | The contracted replacement cost |

The repair estimate and the contracted replacement cost are those on the request's covered coverage determination.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures, contracted replacement cost USD 1,000.00)

- Repair estimate USD 599.99: above zero and below 0.60, so the cash basis is USD 599.99.
- Repair estimate USD 600.00: at 0.60, so the cash basis is USD 1,000.00.
- No repair estimate above zero recorded: the cash basis is USD 1,000.00.
- An earlier repair of the same component authorized 30 days before the settlement date: the cash basis is zero; at 31 days the guarantee no longer applies.
